title: The colored Jones polynomials of the figure-eight knot and its Dehn surgery spaces
note: arXiv:math/0401084. Title and authors read from the held v3 (library/arxiv-math-0401084v3, dated 9 Mar 2006); v1 was titled 'Some limits of the colored Jones polynomials of the figure-eight knot', single author. The corpus cites it for the deformed volume-conjecture normalisation q_eval = exp((u + 2*pi*i)/N), confirmed verbatim in Thm 2.2 of v3 (with Cor. 2.4 for the Dehn-surgery volume and Chern-Simons).
